rationale: Base config: trainer defaults tuned in the single-algorithm cards.
Lower learning rate: steadier but slower actor-critic updates.
Higher learning rate: faster, risk of policy collapse with one step per batch.
Short rollouts (~1 shift): many small, noisy updates.
Long rollouts (~18 shifts): few, low-variance updates.
Stronger entropy bonus: more exploration, slower commitment.
Lighter critic loss weight relative to the policy loss.
Heavier critic loss weight: faster value fitting.
Lower GAE lambda: leans on the critic, lower variance, more bias.
GAE lambda 1: Monte-Carlo-like advantages, high variance, no bias.
